name: FWE / Food Warming Equipment Co
old_description: FREE freight on qualifying school foodservice equipment projects. Limited-time offer.
about:
Food Warming Equipment Company, Inc. (FWE) operates from Portland, Tennessee, where it designs and builds commercial foodservice equipment in the United States. The company invites visitors to explore its products, processes, and a virtual factory tour through its website.

FWE manufactures a range of heated and non-heated cabinets for commercial kitchens, including proofers, heated holding cabinets, rethermalization ovens, heated and non-heated transport cabinets, utility racks, moisture and proofing cabinets, tray line equipment, and pizza holding cabinets. The company runs a direct-from-factory parts program offering same-day shipping and free delivery on OEM replacements through FWEparts.com, and maintains a Quick Ship program with 11 best-selling models ready to ship within 24–48 hours. New product lines such as the ETC-2333-PH and PHTT-2333 series address proofing and holding for items like donut screens up to 23″ × 33″.

The primary market is K–12 school foodservice, where FWE promotes Energy Star–certified models and partners with the School Nutrition Foundation to donate equipment to qualifying districts. The company also serves broader commercial foodservice, pizza operations, and stadium and venue dining, exhibiting alongside partners Hatco and Ovention at events such as the Pizza Expo, ALSD Experience, and SNA Annual National Conference. A network of local sales representatives supports the buying process.

FWE states that its differentiation rests on four pillars: value-driven design and streamlined manufacturing, customer-focused service with a dedicated point of contact, expert design capability for custom equipment, and an award-winning team recognized by customers, reps, dealers, and consultants. Keith Cochran was named General Manager in September 2026.
